title: Tamper-evident hash chain
one_line: Prove that stored records were not altered, removed or reordered.
verified_against: Hash chain, JSONL and in-memory stores, and concurrent appenders on one host tested for real on local files. Ed25519 signing needs the integrity extra. No cross-host store was tested.
snippet:
from briefcase.integrity import HashChainAppender, JsonlHashChainStore, verify_chain_segment

store = JsonlHashChainStore("audit.chain.jsonl")
ok, failing_row = verify_chain_segment(store.load_entries())
